summary: Whether you show it or not, a strong will and deep reserves of energy and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. Owned, you go after what you want and don't back down and you imagine, feel for others, and create.

gift: At your best: you go after what you want and don't back down, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways — or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let drive and anger and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
